hero.name: Nguyễn Lê Khanh
hero.tagline: Content & media, born 2007. I write stories for the things worth keeping.

belief.headline: I want to try the things I never believed I could do.
belief.body: Every time I step into something new — a new community, a new forest, a new story — I get to grow. That is why I chose content work for a conservation project: everywhere I look, there is something worth learning from scratch.

workStudentUnion.headline: I have run comms for a student union.
workStudentUnion.body: From the first single posts to campaigns that ran for weeks in parallel, I learned that a good headline can pull a whole event back to life. Conservation work needs that skill every day.

workContest.headline: I have written content for student contests.
workContest.body: Writing to a brief, to a deadline, to someone else's spirit — while still keeping a voice that makes people stop. That is the discipline I will bring to every piece about the forest, the sea, the land.

workEvents.headline: I have imagined and run events for students.
workEvents.body: From a blank page to the moment everyone is in the right place, at the right time, in the right mood. I know content does not end at the last line — it ends when a community actually steps into the story.

community.headline: I write for a community — not about it.
community.body: Conservation does not survive on distant slogans. It survives because of local families, kids, volunteers — and stories close enough for them to trust. Closing that distance is what I am here for.

learning.headline: I learn, I dig, and I grow with the community.
learning.body: I do not know everything yet — but I know how to ask, how to listen, and how to write down what I hear so that no one gets left out of the story. For a conservation project, that is often worth more than experience.

siteIsSample.headline: No portfolio yet — so I built one.
siteIsSample.body: The page you are scrolling is my first sample: bilingual, hand-crafted, told in scroll. If you like the way I arrange a story here, I will do the same for your project.

ready.headline: Ready.
ready.body: Ready to learn. Ready to write. Ready to go where there are trees, water, and people worth listening to.

contact.headline: I would love to walk this project with you.
contact.body: If you are looking for a writer for an environmental conservation project — I am here, ready to start this week.
